Their mention of shipping high-availability services demonstrates practical application of these skills in production environments.  
EXPERIENCE: Strong — 2.5 years of backend development experience shipping scalable systems handling millions of requests. This shows hands-on expertise with distributed systems and high-performance architecture, which is critical for backend roles.  
SCORE: 92  
RECOMMENDATION: advance  
NOTES: The candidate's experience with Python and Go in production systems (high availability, millions of requests) strongly implies backend engineering capability. While the Compliance Agent may have flagged missing "machine learning" in another context, this job does not require it. Their communication skills and detail orientation are also relevant for collaboration in engineering teams.
